settings.heroStatement: WE CREATE CLEVER, SOPHISTICATED PRODUCTS THAT ARE ORIGINAL IN DESIGN AND MADE TO A HIGH STANDARD FROM CAREFULLY CONSIDERED, ENDURING MATERIALS.

products.name: Offcut Wall Sconce
products.dimensions: Ø 185mm × D 88mm | Integrated 6W Warm Dim LED (2700K)
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 3–5 business days
products.description: Sculpted from hand-selected stone offcuts paired with a precision-machined cylindrical diffuser. Every Offcut Wall Sconce celebrates the natural fracture lines of architectural stone, casting a soft, atmospheric halo across textured plaster or timber walls.

products.name: Tasman Double Pendant
products.dimensions: L 1680mm × H 320mm (Drop adjustable up to 2400mm) | 24V Warm LED
products.leadTime: Made to Order — Ships in 10–14 business days
products.description: A poised architectural statement defined by twin catenary curves suspended from ultra-fine tension cables. Crafted with supple saddle leather and solid turned brass terminals, the Tasman Double Pendant anchors dining rooms and gallery spaces with effortless calm.

products.name: Offcut Candle Holder
products.dimensions: W 130mm × D 110mm × H 45mm (Includes 2 hand-dipped taper candles)
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 2–3 business days
products.description: Born from our zero-waste stone workshop initiative, each Offcut Candle Holder pairs an organic fragment of veined marble with a heavy knurled solid brass collar. No two stone bases are ever identical.

products.name: Code Cascade 12-Light Chandelier
products.dimensions: Canopy Ø 650mm × Custom Drop up to 6000mm | DALI Dimmable
products.description: Designed for double-height voids, grand stairwells, and heritage foyers. Code Cascade orchestrates hand-blown triplex opal glass spheres and linear brass counterweights in a rhythmic vertical composition.

products.name: Koura Cross Linear Pendant
products.dimensions: L 1500mm × H 480mm × D 120mm | Bi-directional Warm LED
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 3–5 business days
products.description: Intersecting architectural brass tubes locked by precision machined joinery. Ideal above kitchen islands and long architectural worktables, offering both task downlighting and ambient ceiling wash.

products.name: Duomo Piccolo Wall Light
products.dimensions: H 145mm × W 90mm × D 105mm | IP44 Bathroom Rated
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 2–4 business days
products.description: A compact domed wall sconce machined from solid brass billet. Engineered with an IP44 moisture rating, making it equally suited for serene bedside reading or fluted stone bathroom vanities.

products.name: La Diosa Sculptural Table Lamp
products.dimensions: Ø 320mm × H 490mm | Rotary Brass Dimmer Switch
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 3–5 business days
products.description: Combining a monolithic turned travertine base with a tactile spun metal shade and tactile brass rotary dimmer. Designed to bring warm architectural intimacy to sideboards, consoles, and reading nooks.

products.name: Terra Amphora Ceramic Vessel
products.leadTime: In Stock — Ships in 2–4 business days
products.description: Wheel-thrown in small batches with twin ear handles inspired by ancient Mediterranean vessels and modern brutalist form. Featured in our dining room editorial atop a carved limestone plinth.

spaces.title: CODE CASCADE
spaces.summary: A custom suspension based on our Code Collection for a stunning 6m high lobby in a heritage listed building.
spaces.story: Commissioned for a landmark heritage refurbishment in Auckland, the Code Cascade installation spans six vertical meters through an arched stairwell void. Twelve solid brass pendants with hand-blown opal spheres were calibrated to follow the natural sightlines of the timber and steel balustrade.

spaces.title: ARMADALE HOUSE
spaces.summary: Warm travertine surfaces and custom Tasman Double Pendants anchor this serene minimalist family residence.
spaces.story: Soft lime-washed walls and monolithic blackened oak furniture are paired with our signature Tasman Double Pendant in terracotta saddle leather, creating an intimate dining sanctuary.

spaces.title: OSTERIA CALMA
spaces.summary: Intersecting Koura linear brass pendants and Duomo sconces bathe fluted oak joinery in a golden evening glow.
spaces.story: Every table and sommelier station at Osteria Calma was lit with 2400K warm-dimming brass luminaires that age gracefully alongside the natural timber and marble.

spaces.title: LAKE HAYES PAVILION
spaces.summary: Raw stone Offcut Wall Sconces echo the rugged Otago landscape inside a tranquil alpine retreat.
spaces.story: Set against schist stone and cedar soffits, the Offcut Wall Sconce and La Diosa Table Lamp bring tactile warmth through the long southern winter evenings.

reviews.author: Clare M. — Interior Architect
reviews.comment: The catenary drape of the Tasman Double Pendant is extraordinary in person. Our client's dining room feels like a serene gallery.

reviews.author: Hendra W.
reviews.comment: Ordered three Offcut Wall Sconces for our travertine hallway. Each piece has its own organic stone silhouette and warm glow.
